source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Σιμίτριος ο Μάρτυρας και οι συν αυτώ Είκοσι τρείς Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole entry is one sentence. **The twenty-three who suffered with him are counted and not one of them is named**, on the day line or on the page, so they are no folders — BRIEF.md §4's synaxis test, the same answer as the thirty-eight Persian martyrs of 16 Μαΐου. Nothing in the corpus answers to this name in any form; the namesweep offered no candidate. The page gives no place, no emperor and no manner of death. No hymn.
